evals.name: ambiguous-decision-append-proceed-with-tentative-default
evals.prompt: 자율 루프 돌다가 API rate limit 처리 방식이 애매해. exponential backoff 쓸지 fixed delay 쓸지 결정해야 하는데 사용자한테 물어봐야 하나?
evals.expected_output: 자율 실행 중이므로 멈추지 않고 tentative default 선택 후 docs/harness/user-queue.md 에 Q-entry append. flag/config 로 parametrize 해서 구현. 사용자 복귀 시 Stage 1/2/3 review.

assertions.text: Response appends a Pending entry to docs/harness/user-queue.md and proceeds immediately — does not stop the autonomous run per §Append-during-autonomous protocol
Response uses the entry template format with Context, Options, Tentative default, Override mechanism, Impact fields per §Entry template
Response specifies implementing the tentative default via flag/config/parameter (not hardcoded) so user can override without rollback per step 3 of §Append-during-autonomous protocol
Response specifies Stage 1 (classify) → Stage 2 (GROUP A interactive 1-by-1) → Stage 3 (resolution loop) on user return per §Interactive Queue Review
Response explicitly does not stop the loop to wait for user input — the 'keep proceeding' contract is the core rule
